title: Angular Quick Reference
description: Find a word or command you have seen in a lesson. Each short note tells you what it does. Open the linked lesson for the full example.

entries.name: Component
entries.summary: A piece of a page, such as a score card.

entries.name: selector
entries.summary: The HTML name used to place this component.

entries.name: template
entries.summary: The HTML that a component shows.

entries.name: ng new
entries.summary: Create the starting files for an Angular app.

entries.name: ng serve
entries.summary: Build the app locally and watch for your changes.

entries.name: Text binding
entries.summary: Put a value into the text shown on a page.

entries.name: Property binding
entries.summary: Set a property using a value from the component.

entries.name: Event binding
entries.summary: Run an action when an event happens.

entries.name: signal
entries.summary: A value Angular can watch for changes.

entries.name: computed
entries.summary: A value worked out from other signals.

entries.name: @if
entries.summary: Show a part of the page only when a rule is true.

entries.name: @for
entries.summary: Show one page part for each item in a list.

entries.name: input
entries.summary: Read a value supplied by a parent component.

entries.name: output
entries.summary: Tell the parent that something happened.

entries.name: routerLink
entries.summary: Go to another route inside the Angular app.

entries.name: inject
entries.summary: Ask Angular for a service the component needs.

entries.name: FormControl
entries.summary: Keep the value and checks for one form field.

entries.name: Validators.required
entries.summary: Require a field to have a value.

entries.name: HttpClient
entries.summary: Read or send data with HTTP requests.

entries.name: Pipe
entries.summary: Change a value for display in a template.

entries.name: @defer
entries.summary: Wait to load part of a page until it is needed.

entries.name: TestBed
entries.summary: Set up Angular parts for a test.

entries.name: setInput
entries.summary: Give a component input a value in a test.

entries.name: ng build
entries.summary: Make files that a web host can serve.

entries.name: loadComponent
entries.summary: Load a route component when that route is needed.
